title: Spatial Layout
description: Room/zone node definitions with display coordinates for the Crusher-to-the-Bridge spatial deck map.

nominal_complement.description: Archetype complement of the hull, split by role. Passengers and crew are separate populations: a passenger denominator must never be compared against their sum.

confinement_isolation_factor.description: Direct-contact/droplet multiplier for quarantined agents in cabin corridors

corridor_direct_contact_factor.description: Base direct-contact multiplier for Cabin_Corridor zones (hallway vs ward)

graywater_zones.description: Downstream greywater/blackwater collection zones for ship-wide wastewater sequencing grid sampling

id.description: Unique zone name (no spaces — use underscores)

volume_m3.description: Room volume in cubic meters (must be > 0, Law 3). When floor_area_m2 and ceiling_height_m are both present, volume_m3 should equal their product (floor_area_m2 * ceiling_height_m).

floor_area_m2.description: CONTAM zone floor area in square meters (must be > 0, Law 3). Optional; combined with ceiling_height_m to derive volume_m3.

ceiling_height_m.description: CONTAM zone ceiling height in meters (must be > 0, Law 3). Optional; combined with floor_area_m2 to derive volume_m3.

elevation_m.description: Relative vertical position of the zone floor in meters (CONTAM level relative elevation). May be negative for decks below the reference datum.

deck.description: Deck or level identifier (platform-specific, e.g. main, saucer_10, 3_Marina)

base_ach.description: Base air changes per hour (optional override)

max_occupancy.description: Nominal max occupants for the zone (simulation / display)

dining_service_type.description: Dining venue class for meal rotation weights and food risk

food_contamination_multiplier.description: Scales food_contamination pathway dose in this Dining zone (buffet > plated)

cabin_ventilation_type.description: Cabin corridor ventilation class (balcony_partial reduces aerosol dose)

cabin_size.description: Stateroom occupancy for cabin-mate pairing (default: 2 pax, 3 crew)
